The grant represents the second installment of RSUs under the consulting agreement (the "

") between the Company and Lotus effective August 29, 2025. Under the Agreement, Lotus provides guidance on capital markets and private equity fundraising, investment opportunities, market positioning, acquisition candidates and potential acquirers of the Company. The Agreement excludes investor relations activities, as defined in the policies of the TSX Venture Exchange (the "

The RSUs have been granted as Share-Settled Share Units under the Company's Omnibus Share Incentive Plan and will vest one (1) year from the date of grant. Upon settlement, each vested RSU will entitle Lotus to receive one subordinate voting share of the Company.

Edge Total Intelligence Inc. (edgeTI) is a defense-technology company focused on actively mitigating the consequences of inaction and poor decisions in critical operations. Its edgeCore™ platform reaches data where it already lives, without moving it or taking custody of it, reshaping the data into governed operational context. It then coordinates the people, systems and AI models acting in context — arbitrating, bounding, monitoring and recording every decision on the loop. edgeTI's applications, process logic and data ontology serve military branches, joint and allied forces, and the maritime, manufacturing and critical-infrastructure supply chains behind them. edgeTI is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia.
